title: Lost Woods Secret Cave Entrance
description: Lift up the center bush and drop down.

title: Lost Woods Secret Cave Exit
description: The secret entrance is nearby, under the cluster of bushes.

title: Kakariko Well (Secret Cave Entrance)
description: Location: Northwest Kakariko Village Drop into the opening from the ledge above. Contains five Chests with 60 Rupees and bomb refills, as well as a Piece of Heart.

title: Kakariko Cave Exit
description: The upper portion of the cave can only be accessed via the well to the west.

title: Desert of Mystery Cave
description: Cave entrance that leads to Aginah and a Piece of Heart

title: Lake Hylia Secret Ice Cave Entrance
description: Bomb the wall to enter the cave.

title: Secret Rupee Cave
description: Life the stone slab to enter. The Blue Rupees in the pots respawn when you exit, making this the best money-farming spot in the game.

title: North Hyrule Fairy Fountain Cave
description: This cave opening is one-way only -- you can exit here from the Fairy Fountain.

title: Return Passage from Death Mountain
description: Connects to (one-way): [Return Passage to Kakariko Village Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=429768)

title: Death Mountain Access Ave (Kakariko Village Return Path)
Death Mountain Fairy Cave
description: While not a true Fairy Fountain, there is a cave here with small fairies you can catch.

title: Hollow Tree Cave and Fairy Fountain Exit
description: Enter through the [Hollow Tree Cave Secret Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430050) to get to the Piece of Heart and Small Fairy Fountain inside.

title: Hollow Tree Cave Secret Entrance
description: Requirement: Defeated Agahnim in the Hyrule Castle Tower Open up this secret entrance by slamming into the tree with your Pegasus Boots.

title: Desert Plateau Cave
description: Location: Light World, accessible only via Magic Mirror from the Dark World The cave contains pots and a Piece of Heart.

title: East Death Mountain Cave
description: Area behind the block is accessible from the top entrance on the summit of Death Mountain. Drop into a pit to land here, then bomb to the wall to access the two treasure rooms nearby.

title: Plains of Ruin Cave
description: Bomb the wall to open the passage

title: Mad Batter Cave (Secret Entrance)
description: Fall into the opening to enter

title: Graveyard Cave
description: Access by using the Magic Mirror in the equivalent spot in the Dark World

title: The Cave
description: Called just "The Cave" on the nearby sign, this Dark World equivalent to Sanctuary is home to the Storyteller Octopus who will give you a hint for 20 Rupees.

title: Tree Trunk Cave
description: Pound down all the pegs to open up a hidden passage in the tree trunk.

title: Desert Heart Cave
description: Access via the Dark World. Lift the stone slab.

title: Swamp of Evil Storyteller Cave
description: Contains Storyteller and a bombable wall with a hidden room and pots.

title: Death Mountain Dark World Treasure Cave
description: You'll need to the Magic Cape, Hammer, and Titan's Mitt for this one.

title: Lake Hylia Treasure Cave
description: Receive 300 Rupees from the thief in this hideout, as well as additional refills and Rupees from four chests inside.

title: Lake Hylia Thief's Hideout
description: A thief is guarding four pots with Blue Rupees and offers up advice: "You can earn a lot of Rupees by defeating enemies. It's the secret of my success..."

title: Ice Lake Hint Cave
description: Hint tablet: Link, di you know that if you destroy frozen enemies with the Hammer, you will often get a Magic Decanter?"

title: Storyteller Hand
description: Pay 20 Rupees for a hint. The Hand tells you it was a thief in the Light World and that a master locksmith went into hiding: the strange midde-aged guy.

title: Death Mountain Shop Cave
description: Bomb the wall on the northwest side to access the shop

title: Spectacle Rock Cave (Lower Left Entrance)
description: Drop down to this entrance from above and follow the cave to the Spectacle Rock Fairy Fountain

title: Spectacle Rock Cave
description: Hookshot over the pit to the plaque -- or drop down to the Fairy Fountain walkway.

title: Death Mountain Dark World Fairy Fountain Cave
East Death Mountain Cave (Upper Entrance)
description: Drop into the pit to access the area with the bombable exit to the [Treasure Chests (2)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430183) below. Take the stairs to get to the [Treasure Chests (5)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430184).

title: Death Mountain Treasure Cave (Upper Entrance)
description: Narrow cave passage with Mini-Moldorms and Bari that leads to a pit. Pit leads to a treasure chest on a platform containing 50 Rupees. See: [Treasure Chest (1)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430185)

title: East Death Mountain Dark World Cave
description: Follow the path and take the stairs to get to the two chests. See: [Treasure Chest (2)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431499)

title: East Death Mountain Dark World Cave (Lower Entrance)
description: Follow the left path (the narrow path dead-ends in blocks). Drop into the pit blocking the path to get beyond the blocks. Push the left block up and take the stairs up. Fall into the right pit to get beyond the other two blocks. Take the stairs up to an area with Hardhat Beetles and three pits. All three drop down to the block puzzle and treasure chests. See: [Treasure Chest (2)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431499)

title: Turtle Rock (West Cave Entrance)
description: Accessible only from within the Turtle Rock dungeon.

title: Death Mountain Piece of Heart Cave
description: Accessible only via the Dark World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=439896).

title: Fairy
description: Cut the bushes to release a Fairy (refills your hearts, can be caught)

title: Turtle Rock Fairy Room
description: Type: Small Fairy Room A single fairy floats in the room north of the tile room. Pick up the pot for a full Magic Energy refill.

title: Ganon's Tower Fairy Room
description: Type: Small Fairy Room Smash into the barrier on the third floor walkway with the Pegasus Shoes to knock yourself over to the platform on the other side and then bomb the wall. Two fairies float in a room.

title: Ganon's Tower Fairy Pit
description: Type: Small Fairy Room After beating the mini-bosses, head west and through the bombable north wall to find a room with an open pit and four fairies.

title: Fairy
description: Smash into the tree to reveal a fairy

title: Fairy
description: Smash into the tree to release a fairy

title: Fairy
description: Smash into the tree to release a Fairy

title: Fairy
description: Lift the bush to release this Stray Fairy

title: Fairy
description: Dash into the stones to release a stray fairy

title: Fairies
description: Dash into the rocks to release stray fairies

title: Fairies (x2)
description: Inside the Death Mountain Fairy Cave

title: Fairy
description: Smash into the tree with the Pegasus Shoes (early game)

title: Lake Hylia Isle Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Bomb the east wall for a secret room with four fairies.

title: North Hyrule Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Great Fairy Fountain Lift the bush to find a secret entrance to the Fairy Fountain.

title: Spectacle Rock Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Location: Inside the Death Mountain Cave Enter through the [Spectacle Rock Fairy Fountain Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431478) or drop into the hole south of the Sahasrahla plaque and head east to find three fairies you can catch

title: East Hyrule Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Catch or use the four small fairies to replenish your health.

title: Eastern Palace Fairy Room
description: Type: Small Fairy Room Drop into the left vase on 1F.

title: Tower of Hera Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Fall into the pit on the north wall on the fifth floor and you'll land in this secret room on the first floor.

title: Dark Palace Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Bomb the right wall in this 1F Room

title: Ice Palace Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Located on B5.

title: Waterfall of Wishing
description: Type: Special Fairy Fountain Also known as the Mysterious Pond

title: Central Hyrule Dark World Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Smash into the rocks to open up a hidden entrance

title: Death Mountain Small Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Small Fairy Fountain Accessible with the Hookshot

title: Death Mountain Dark World Fairy Fountain
Death Mountain Great Fairy Fountain
description: Type: Great Fairy Fountain Inside Hookshot Cave, bomb the north wall. Go through the door and now bomb the north wall in the next section of the cave as well, a cross-shaped junction.

title: Link's House
description: Link's House is where Link's adventure starts. Whenever you restart your quest, you can select Link's House as your starting point. Other starting areas are added later in the quest. Link's house contains the first item, the Lamp, and three heart refills underneath the pots.

title: Secret Entrance to Hyule Castle Dungeon
description: Pick up the bush and find a secret entrance to drop into.

title: Sanctuary
description: Hyrule's Sanctuary is unlocked as a start destination after completing Hyrule Castle Dungeon and saving Princess Zelda.

title: Swamp Ruins
description: The Swamp Ruins is a small dungeon that contains a lever to drain the water outside.

title: Eastern Ruins
description: Home to the Eastern Palace and where you meet Sahasrahla to kick off the quest for the Pendants and the Master Sword.

title: Eastern Palace
description: Home of the Pendant of Courage and part of the Light World Master Sword quest.

title: Sahasrahla's Cottage
description: Location: North Kakariko Village Meet the Elder's wife to further your quest.

title: Thieves' Hideout
description: Location: North Kakariko Village Used to be a hideout for a gang of thieves. Contains four chests with red Rupees (80) and a Piece of Heart.

title: Weathercock
description: Play the Flute in front of this weather vane to release the bird inside, which can be summoned to warp around the world.

title: Kakariko Inn
description: Location: South Kakariko Village The inn has two entrances -- the back entrance leads to a Bottle.

title: Kakariko Shack
description: Bomb the front wall to enter.

title: Light World Fortune Teller
description: Pay between 10 and 30 Rupees to get a hint. Also refills your hearts.

title: Dark Palace
description: Pay Kiki the Monkey 100 Rupees to open the front door

title: Shooting Gallery
description: Archery challenge mini-game. Pay 20 Rupees to win up to 124 Rupees.

title: Overgrown House
description: The man inside provides back story on the missing bird

title: Treasure Chest Game - Dark World
description: Pay 30 Rupees to play and win Rupees or a Piece of Heart

title: Misery Mire
description: Use the Ether Medallion to open the dungeon

title: Ice Palace
description: Access via Light World warp in this spot

title: Lost Woods Treasure Chest Game
description: Pay 100 Rupees to open a chest. You have a one in three chance of winning 300 Rupees.

title: Twin Lumberjacks' Woodsmen's Hut
description: The house of lumberjacks A Bumpkin and B Bumpkin.

title: Hyrule Castle Sewers Treasure Room
description: Access via the tombstone in the graveyard. Bomb one of the two wall openings and find three treasure chests (300 Rupees, Bombs, Arrows) and six pots (4 heart refills).

title: Death Mountain Bridge
description: Use the Magic Hammer to get past the pegs.

title: Zora's Waterfall
description: Location reachable by exiting to the north of Zora's Domain.

title: Skull Woods Entrance
description: Point of Interest localizado em world.

title: Skull Woods Entrance
description: Point of Interest localizado em world.

title: Skull Woods Entrance
description: Point of Interest localizado em world.

title: Skull Woods Entrance
description: Point of Interest localizado em world.

title: Skull Woods Entrance
description: Point of Interest localizado em world.

title: Skull Woods Entrance
description: Point of Interest localizado em world.

title: Desert Palace Monolith
description: Use the Book of Mudora to read the inscription and open up the dungeon entrance.

title: Witch's Hut
description: Red Potion: 120 Rupees Green Potion: 60 Rupees Blue Potion: 160 Rupees

title: Shop
description: Sells: * 1x Red Potion (150) * 1x Blue Shield (50) * 10x Bombs (50)

title: Lake Hylia Shop
description: Sells: * 1x Red Potion (150) * 1x Heart refill (10) * 10x Bombs (50)

title: Duck Warp
description: Release the duck from the weathercock to unlock it as a warp feature. The duck picks you up anywhere on the map when using the Flute.

title: Dark World Warp
description: Requires Hammer and Power Glove to get to this warp and to the Dark World [Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434766)

title: Dark World Warp
description: The Hyrule Castle entrance becomes a warp after Link defeats Agahnim. It leads to this [Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434764)

title: Dark World Warp
description: This portion of the grove requires the Titan's Mitt to lift the dark stone slab at its entrance

title: Dark World Warp
description: Requires the Magic Hammer to pound down the pegs blocking the way

title: Dark World Warp
description: Requires the Titan's Mitt to lift the dark rock Grants access to the Dark World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434745)

title: Dark World Warp
description: Requires the Flute and the Titan's Mitt to access. Warps to the Dark World's [Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434772)

title: Dark World Warp
description: Requires the Titan's Mitt to access

title: Dark World Warp
description: This warp point is hidden until you climb up (Titan's Mitt required) and pound down the stakes in this order: bottom-right, top, bottom-left [1. Pound this peg first](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430161) [2. Pound this peg second](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430162) [3. Pound this peg third](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430163)

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into it to warp to the [Warp Whirl](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430508) near the northern waterfalls.

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into it to warp to the Swamp's [Warp Whirl](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430507).

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the [Whirlpool Waterway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430887) near the Waterfall of Wishing.

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the [Whirlpool Waterway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430885) in Lake Hylia.

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the northwest Hyrule [Whirlpool Waterway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430889).

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the east Lake Hylia [Whirlpool Waterway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430888).

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the Ice Lake's [Whirlpool Waterway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430891).

title: Whirlpool Waterway
description: Swim into the whirlpool to warp to the Dark World riverlands [Whirlpool Waterway](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430890).

title: Heart Container 1
description: Location: Sanctuary, in a Chest The first Heart Container Link collects is found in a treasure chest inside Sanctuary.

title: Heart Container 2
description: Location: Boss Chamber, 1F Northern Room The second Heart Container will upgrade Link's health meter by a full heart. Defeat the Boss to get it.

title: Heart Container 5
description: Location: Dark Palace B1 Defeat the boss

title: Piece of Heart (1/24)
description: Location: In the pond next to the Swamp Ruins Pull the lever inside the Swamp Ruins to drain the water and exit to collect the Piece of Heart.

title: Piece of Heart (2/24)
description: Location: In a secret cave in the Lost Woods Drop into the secret cave entrance under the bush. Exit through the hollow tree stump.

title: Piece of Heart (3/24)
description: Location: In the Thieves' Hideout Basement Bomb the cracked wall on the north wall. The Piece of Heart is inside a Treasure Chest.

title: Piece of Heart (4/24)
description: Location: At the end of the Maze Race, southwest Hyrule Talk to the woman and she will set you the challenge to beat the maze race in 15 seconds. Slash -- don't stab or lift -- the line of bushes going up/north, then walk to the top row and slash the bushes horizontally to the left/west and head down to the finish.

title: Piece of Heart (5/24)
description: Location: Inside the Secret Cave Bomb the crack in the wall on the north wall to access a secret corridor with pots and a chest containing the Piece of Heart.

title: Piece of Heart (6/24)
description: Location: Inside the Desert Cave Bomb the south wall in the room with Aginah for a secret chamber with a treasure chest containing the Piece of Heart.

title: Piece of Heart (7/24)
description: Location: In a secret cave under Dash into the pile of rocks using the Pegasus Boots to reveal a cave entrance. The Heart Piece is in a chest inside.

title: Piece of Heart (8/24)
description: Location: On a rocky plateau in the Desert of Mystery Enter the Desert Palace (using the Book of Mudora) and exit from the southwest room on B1. Follow the plateau south.

title: Piece of Heart (9/24)
description: Location: In a small forest clearing, off the visible map Use the Power Glove to lift the stone slab near the Witch's Hut, and continue on the path all the way to the north. Jump into the water and head east, then swim down the waterfall. Swim south and head west to find the Heart Piece.

title: Piece of Heart (10/24)
description: Location: Inside a Death Mountain Cave Jump off the cliff edge above the second rock balcony and go inside the cave to find the heart

title: Piece of Heart (11/24)
description: Location: Light World, Spectacle Rock Use the Magic Mirror when on the outline of Spectacle Rock in the Dark World to get to this unmissable heart.

title: Piece of Heart (12/24)
description: Walk down the right-hand side stairway in front of you, and go right along the side of the pyramid until you can jump down. The Piece of Heart is on the rightmost ledge.

title: Piece of Heart (13/24)
description: Location: Underground in the [Hollow Tree Cave Secret Entrance](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430050) Requirement: Accessible after defeating Agahnim

title: Piece of Heart (14/24)
description: Swim to the location of this isle in the Dark World and use the Mirror to travel to the Light World

title: Piece of Heart (15/24)
description: Location: Inside the Light World Desert Plateau Cave Step into the ring of bushes in the Dark World and use the Magic Mirror

title: Piece of Heart (21/24)
description: To the left of the Misery Mire dungeon entrance, enter the tree-trunk looking structure and solve the block puzzle inside.

title: Piece of Heart (17/24)
description: Use the Magic Mirror on the ledge in the Dark World to access this cave. Bomb the north wall.

title: Piece of Heart (18/24)
description: Access this Piece of Heart via the [Death Mountain Dark World Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430526). Requirements: Power Glove, Hookshot, Magic Cape

title: Piece of Heart (19/24)
description: Pay 30 Rupees to open two chests. The Piece of Heart is in a random chest.

title: Piece of Heart (20/24)
description: Pound down all the pegs nearby to open up the cave. The Piece of Heart is underground in the [Tree Trunk Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430867).

title: Piece of Heart (22/24)
description: Inside the Desert Heart Cave. Push the blocks out of the way to reach it.

title: Piece of Heart (16/24)
description: Found in a random location in the Digging Field

title: Piece of Heart (24/24)
description: Accessible only by warping from the Dark World when on the rock balcony outside of Turtle Rock.

title: Piece of Heart (23/24)
description: Enter via the Death Mountain Hookshot Cave in the Dark World. Find the exit to the plateau and then warp to the Light World with the Magic Mirror.

title: Fighter's Sword
description: Location: Secret Passage, Hyrule Dungeon Receive the Fighter's Sword from Link's Uncle in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon

title: Fighter's Shield
description: Location: Secret Passage, Hyrule Dungeon Receive the Fighter's Shield from Link's Uncle in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon.

title: Boomerang
description: Location: Hyrule Castle Dungeon The Boomerang is found in the Hyrule Castle Dungeon basement, in a treasure chest.

title: Bow and Arrow
description: Location: 1F Large Central Room Found in the large chest in the dungeon's biggest room. Requires the Big Key to open.

title: Bug-Catching Net
description: Receive the Bug-Catching Net from the sick boy. It can be used to catch bees and fairies and keep them in bottles.

title: Ice Rod
description: Location: Inside the Lake Hylia Ice Cave Bomb the wall to enter. Use the Ice Rod to freeze enemies.

title: Pegasus Shoes
description: Location: Sahasrahla's Hideout Receive after getting the Pendant of Courage

title: Flippers
description: Location: Zora's Waterfall Walk through the river shallows in northeast Hyrule and buy the Flippers from King Zora for 500 Rupees.

title: Master Sword
description: Collect the three pendants to retrieve the Master Sword from the Lost Woods clearing

title: Shovel
description: Receive from the Transformed Flute Boy

title: Flute
description: The Flute Boy's ocarina is buried here. Dig it up with the Shovel.

title: Magic Hammer
description: Location: Dark Palace 1F In the long hall with the crumbling walkway, accessible via a bombable wall

title: Tempered Sword
description: Reunite the two Dwarven Blacksmiths. Requires finding and rescuing the [Lost Frog](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430876) with the Titan's Mitt.

title: Golden Sword
description: Offer the Cursed Fairy your Tempered Sword

title: Silver Arrows
description: Offer the Cursed Fairy your Bow and Arrows

title: Cane of Byrna
description: Inside the [Death Mountain Dark World Treasure Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430892)

title: Titan's Mitts
description: The Titan's Mitts are found in the southwestern room on B2. With them, you can lift dark stones and slabs.

title: Blue Mail
description: Bomb the floor in the eastern-most room on B4 and drop down to the treasure chest on B5. Open with the Big Key

title: Mirror Shield
description: Enter this cave by exiting on this rock outcropping from the Turtle Rock dungeon. Use the Hookshot or the Cane of Somaria to cross the small gap and use the Big Key to open the big treasure chest there.

title: Ganon's Tower
description: Gather all seven Crystals to open this dungeon

title: Pots with Bomb Refills
description: Location: Inside the doorless shack Bomb the front wall to enter. Items respawn.

title: Bombs
description: Slam into the rocks to get a bomb refill

title: Bombs (10)
description: You can purchase 10 Bombs for 50 Rupees

title: Bombs (4)
description: Dash into the tree to make a bomb refill appear

title: Super Bomb
description: Purchase late in the quest to open the Cursed Fairy Fountain

title: Bottle (1/4)
description: Location: Kakariko Village stall Purchase for 100 Rupees

title: Bottle (2/4)
description: Location: Kakariko Inn Back Room Enter through the backdoor and find the Bottle in the chest.

title: Bottle (4/4)
description: Bring the [Purple Treasure Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430883) to the [Average Middle-Aged Man](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430880) and he will open it in exchange for your silence.

title: Treasure Chests (4)
description: Location: In the basement of the Thieves' Hideout Four chests contain a Red Rupee each (80 Rupees).

title: Treasure Chests (4)
description: Location: Inside the Secret Cave Fall into the well to access the upper portion of the Secret Cave. The first treasure chest contains bombs, the other three contain one Red Rupee each (60 Rupees).

title: Treasure Chests (3)
description: Three chests behind a bombable wall contain Green Rupees (2x50) and bombs.

title: Treasure Chests (2)
description: Enter through the [East Death Mountain Cave (Upper Entrance)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431494) and fall into the pit inside the cave, then bomb the north wall for two chests containing bombs and arrows.

title: Treasure Chests (5)
description: Access via the pit inside the [East Death Mountain Cave (Upper Entrance)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431494). Defeat the three Moldorms to reopen the door. Hit the switch in this room for five chests containing a Red Rupee each (100 Rupees)

title: Treasure Chest (1)
description: Enter through the cave entrance on the balcony above, then follow the path and drop into a pit to get to a chest with 50 Rupees

title: Treasure Chests (4)
description: Inside the Plains of Ruin Cave, you'll find Pikku and a bombable wall. Behind it, there are four chests with Red Rupees, for a total of 80 Rupees.

title: Treasure Chests (2)
description: The left one contains the Piece of Heart while the right one holds a Red Rupee (50).

title: Treasure Chests (4)
description: Inside the Death Mountain Hookshot Cave. Each contains 50 Ruppes, for a total of 200.

title: Purple Treasure Chest
description: The key to the chest is locked inside. You have to bring it to the [Average Middle-Aged Man](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430880) to unlock it. It contains a Bottle.

title: Treasure Chest (4)
description: Four treasure chests with Rupees, bombs, and arrows

title: Lamp
description: Location: Link's House, in a Chest The Lamp is in the treasure chest in the lower right corner. Use it light torches or burn things.

title: Pendant of Courage
description: Location: Boss Chamber, 1F Northern Room Defeat the Easter Palace Boss to receive one of three pendants, the Pendant of Courage.

title: Eastern Palace Big Key
description: Location: 1F, West Destroy all enemies in the room to make the Bubble Group scatter. You can now open the treasure chest in the north half.

title: Hyrule Castle Dungeon Big Key
description: Location: Hyrule Dungeon, defeat the Ball and Chain Trooper The Big Key is used to unlock Zelda's cell.

title: Mushroom
description: Location: Mushroom locations are randomized Bring the Mushroom to the Witch in Eastern Hyrule.

title: Book of Mudora
description: Location: On a shelf inside the Library Use the Pegasus Shoes to slam into the shelf and make it drop. The book translates ancient Hylian.

title: Magical Boomerang
description: Toss the Boomerang in the Mysterious Pond

title: Red Shield
description: Toss the Fighter's Shield in the Mysterious Pond

title: Ether Medallion
description: Location: Across the bridge, inside the stone pedestal Use the Book of Mudora to read the Hylian text, then raise the Master Sword.

title: Quake Medallion
description: Throw anything (rock, bush, bomb, etc.) into the Circle of Stones and the Catfish will come out and give you the Quake Medallion.

title: Dark Palace Crystal
description: Location: Dark Palace B1 Defeat the boss

title: Bombos Medallion
description: Use the Magic Mirror nearby in the Dark World's [Light World Plateau Access Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430171) to access the plateau. Read the Hylian Plaque with the Book of Mudora.

title: Magic Cape
description: Enter the Hidden Crypt by pushing the tomb stone (using the [Titan's Mitts](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430898)) and collect the Cape from the treasure chest inside.

title: Hookshot
description: Inside the big chest in the large, waterlogged room

title: Fire Rod
description: Inside the big chest in this entrance room (but not accessible until after exploring the various areas, getting the [Skull Woods Big Key](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430796) and triggering a switch).

title: Skull Woods Big Key
description: Pull the statue onto the switch to enter the room with the chest containing the key

title: Thieves' Town Big Key
description: The Thieves' Town Big Key is in a treasure chest on the B1 entry hall, accessible from the room to the east.

title: Good Bee
description: Dash into the statue inside the Fairy Fountain to release the Good Bee. Catch it with your net to store it in a Bottle. When released, the Good Bee will attack Link's foes.

title: Misery Mire Big Key
description: Expand a room on 1F and drop into a pit to land on a B1 room with the key in the southeast corner of the dungeon.

title: Cane of Somaria
description: Found on B1 at the end of a crumbling pathway

title: Ice Palace Big Key
description: In the western-most room on B1. Accessible via the stairs from B2.

title: Magic Powder
description: Give the Mushroom to the Witch and exit the area and come back to receive the Magic Powder.

title: Magic Mirror
description: While exploring the Death Mountain Cave, you'll run into an old man, who you need to guide higher up into the mountain. To thank you, he gives you the Magic Mirror.

title: Red Rupee
description: Slam into the tree with your Pegasus Boots (late game)

title: Rupees (300)
description: Underground, inside Hyrule Castle Sewers Treasure Room

title: 4x Blue Rupees (20)
description: Pull on the Turtle Rock claw

title: Treasure Chest (2)
description: Push the blocks aside to get Bombs and a Red Rupee. Accessible from the entrance to the [East Death Mountain Dark World Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431500) above. The skull pot nearby contains a Magic Ampule.

title: Blue Rupee (5)
description: Smash into the tree with the Pegasus Shoes (early game).

title: Boss: Armos Knights
description: Location: Boss Chamber, 1F Northern Room A group of six hopping Armos Knights is found in the Boss Chamber. The easiest way to dispatch them is to equip your Bow and Arrow and shoot each of them three times.

title: Ball and Chain Trooper
description: Location: Hyrule Castle Dungeon Jail The Ball and Chain Trooper acts as a boss for the dungeon. Use pots to easily take him out from a distance.

title: Boss: Moldorm
description: Use your sword and strike him at the end of his tail to damage him. Each time you hit him, he'll get faster and more aggressive with his movements. Stay way from the edges, jeep moving, and get him in his tail when he circles around to go the other way.

title: Boss: Agahnim
description: Face Agahnim on 7F after getting the Master Sword from the Lost Woods.

title: Boss: Helmasaur King
description: Location: Dark Palace B1 Destroy the head armor with the Magic Hammer, then slash at the jewel in his head

title: Boss: Arrghus
description: Use your Hookshot to grab the balls that surround him (and shield him), killing each of them individually. Then slash at the cyclops jellyfish as it comes for you.

title: Boss: Mothula
description: Vulnerable to fire. Use the Fire Rod.

title: Boss: Blind the Thief
description: Expose the Maiden to light to reveal this boss. Slash at him and his heads with the sword while avoiding the beams and collisions.

title: Boss: Vitreous
description: Slash at the eyes of this dungeon boss while avoiding its lightning attacks. The last phase is the eyeball hopping around -- sword attacks will defeat it easily.

title: Toppo (Only Appear up to Dark World Discovery)
description: Only appear early in Link's quest.

title: Forest Thief
description: Thief will collide with Link and steal items

title: Boss: Trinexx
description: Defeat by stunning its Fire and Ice heads with the Ice and Fire Rods, respectively, then attacking with the Sword. The final head/form is taken down with the Sword.

title: Boss: Agahnim II
description: Hit his energy balls back at him using the Sword or Bug-Catching Net. Fake copies of the wizard have a lighter-colored shadow.

title: Fish Rescue Secret
description: Drain the water in the Swamp Ruins to make a fish appear. Carry it up to the pond and toss it into the dark blue waters. You'll get a Red Rupee for your kindness.

title: Cracked Wall
description: Bomb the wall to reunite the Quarreling Brothers

title: Obstacle Course: Maze Race
description: Talk to the woman and then finish the race in 15 seconds or less to win a Piece of Heart.

title: Kakariko Inn Back Door
description: Enter through this door to get to the treasure inside

title: Apple Tree (Early) or Beehive (Late)
description: Slam into the tree to drop health-refilling apples or bees depending on where you are in your quest

title: Energy Barrier
description: Use the Master Sword to destroy the energy barrier blocking the entrance to the tower.

title: Apple Tree
description: Smash into it to release health-restoring apples

title: Talking Tree
description: Hint: "Wow! I haven't seen a normal person in a few hundred years! Let me talk to you for a while. I heard that using Bombs is the best way to defeat the one-eyed giants. That's all I know!"

title: Secret Room
description: Bomb the north wall for a small, secret room with heart refills.

title: Sign
description: Get a hint at what to do with the Circle of Rocks

title: Peg Barrier
description: Use the Magic Hammer to pound them down

title: Peg Barrier
description: Use the Magic Hammer to pound them down

title: Peg Barrier
description: Use the Magic Hammer to pound it down

title: Peg Barrier
description: Pound down the pegs with the Magic Hammer for access

title: Talking Tree
description: Provides a hint: "Wow! I haven't seen a normal person in a few hundred years! Let me talk to you for a while. Surprisingly, the Triforce created this world to fulfill Ganon's wish. What is Ganon's wish, you ask? It is to rule the entire cosmos! Don't you think it might be possible with the power of the Triforce behind you?"

title: Talking Tree
description: Hint: "Wow! I haven't seen a normal person in a few hundred years! Let me talk to you for a while. I once lived in the Lost Woods, until the day I wandered into a magic transporter… The power of the Dark World quickly turned me into this tree shape… I guess the two forests are connected with each other…"

title: Talking Tree
description: Hint: "Wow! I haven't seen a normal person in a few hundred years! Let me talk to you for a while. Do you know about the Gargoyle statue in the village? People say they can hear a girl calling for help from under the statue. Isn't that a strange story…"

title: 3. Pound this peg third
description: Use the Magic Hammer The [Dark World Warp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430160) will appear

title: Beehive
description: Dash into the tree to make bees swarm (late game)

title: Sign
description: Wanted poster: "Wanted! This is the criminal who kidnapped Zelda. Call a sodier if you see him!"

title: Rupee Portrait
description: Pull on the portrait to get 20 Rupees

title: Sign
description: "This way → Eastern Palace This way ← Hyrule Castle"

title: Treasure Chest Game - Light World
description: Pay 20 Rupees to open one of three randomized chests. Win up to 50 Rupees

title: Peg Barrier
description: Use the Magic Hammer to pound it down

title: Mad Batter Altar
description: Sprinkle Magic Powder on the altar to upgrade Link's magic meter and double its power

title: Sign
description: "I'll give a piece of Heart to the person who wears the Cape."

title: Access Point to Hidden Crypt in the Light World
description: Warp to the Light World inside the enclosure to get to the corresponding [Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434769)

title: Hidden Crypt
description: Push the tombstone to reveal a secret entrance.

title: Sign
description: This way ↑ Skeleton Forest This way ↓ Village of Outcasts

title: Talking Tree
description: "Wow! I haven't seen a normal person in a few hundred years! Let me talk to you for a while. Do you know about the Gargoyle statue in the village? People say they can hear a girl calling for help from under the statue. Isn't that a strange story…"

title: Sign
description: "← Swamp of Evil No Entrance No Escape"

title: Apple Tree
description: Dash into it to drop healing apples

title: Swamp Palace Big Key
description: Drop into the hole in the west-most room on 1F. Head east through the door. If you didn't lower the orange blocks, you'll have to backtrack to the room with the crystal switch and lower them and then come back.

title: Peg Puzzle
description: Pound down all pegs with the Hammer

title: Sign
description: "Pay no attention to the average middle-aged man standing by this sign."

title: Ganon Boss Battle Exit
description: If you fall off the platform during the final battle with Ganon, you'll exit from here to go back to the top of the Pyramid. There's no way to jump up here.

title: Sign
description: "The Waterfall of Wishing is just around the corner."

title: Sign
description: "This way ↑→ Magic Shop Waterfall of Wishing"

title: Sign
description: "Wanted! This is the criminal who kidnapped Zelda. Call a soldier if you see him!"

title: Sign
description: "Danger! Do not enter Death Mountain without the King's permission!"

title: Secret Entrance Hyrule Castle Sewers
description: Lift the stones and push the tombstone upwards to open a hole down to the sewers

title: Apple Tree (Early) or Beehive (Late)
description: Charge into this tree to drop health-refilling apples. In the late game, bees will spawn instead.

title: Sign
description: "This cave leads to the path back to Kakariko Village."

title: Sign
description: "This is the Village of the Outcasts. People without Rupees are not welcome here."

title: Sign
description: "This is the Village of Outcasts. People without Rupees are not welcome here."

title: Sign
description: "This is the Village of Outcasts. People without Rupees are not welcome here."

title: Sign
description: "This is the Village of Outcasts. People without Rupees are not welcome here."

title: Duck
description: Play the Flute here to release the Bird, which enables fast-travel.

title: 1/2 Magic Power
description: Upgrade your magic meter by sprinkling Magic Powder on the [Mad Batter Altar](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430491)

title: Sahasrahla
description: Meet up with the Elder Sahasrahla as part of the main quest.

title: Loyal Sage
description: Meet the Loyal Sage after rescuing Zelda to receive your next quest marker.

title: Shasrahla's Wife
description: The Elder's wife provides hints as to his location and other quest support.

title: Boy (Cucco Pen)
description: The Boy is waiting near the cucco pen. He will provide a location for Sahasrahla.

title: Older Quarreling Brother
description: Location: Inside the long house in southwest Hyrule

title: Younger Quarreling Brother
description: Location: Inside the long house in southwest Hyrule

title: Woman (Maze Race)
description: Talk to the woman and she will set you the challenge to beat the maze race in 15 seconds. Slash -- don't stab or lift -- the line of bushes going up, then walk to the top row and slash the bushes horizontally to the left and head down to the finish.

title: Man (Maze Race)
description: Talk to the man (by running into him) at the end of the race to get your completion time. If it's exactly or below 15 seconds, you win the prize.

title: Aginah
description: The Elder Aginah tells you about the fate of the seven wise men in the Golden Land.

title: Bug-Catching Kid
description: This sick boy is asleep in his bed. Wake him to get the Bug-Catching Net.

title: Witch
description: The Witch will create the Magic Powder for you if you bring her a Mushroom from the Lost Woods

title: Shopkeeper / Maple
description: This Potion Shop features three potions: Red Potion: 120 Rupees Green Potion: 60 Rupees Blue Potion: 160 Rupees The shopkeeper in the GBA version is Maple

title: Camper
description: Location: Under the Bridge Talk to the camper who is dozing in front of his tent to receive a Bottle.

title: Bully and his Friend
description: Once human, the Bully and his friend are transformed into an Oni and a ball-shaped creature

title: Catfish
description: The Catfish who resides in the Circle of Stones put up a sign nearby to tell you NOT to throw anything into the ring.

title: Storyteller Tree
description: Talk to the transformed hermit to learn about the Golden Power (the Triforce).

title: Storyteller Bird
description: Pay the Storyteller 20 Rupees for a hint.

title: Flute Boy's Father
description: Talk to him after receiving the Flute to get a hint on how to use it (and confirmation that you can keep it)

title: Tavern Guest
description: This old man tells you about the Waterfall of Wishing

title: Cucco Woman
description: Sprinkle Magic Powder on the Cucco found under the pot in this house to turn it into a human woman. She will tell you that the weathercock helps Cuccos take revenge on those that attack them.

title: Pikku (Friendly)
description: Talk to him to receive 300 Rupees

title: Fortune Teller
description: Pay between 10 and 30 Rupees to get a hint. Also refills your hearts.

title: Fortune Teller
description: Pay between 10 and 30 Rupees to get a hint. Also refills your hearts.

title: Storyteller Insect
description: Pay 20 Rupees to get a hint.

title: Lost Frog
description: The Lost Frog is the transformed Dark World version of one of the two Dwarven Blacksmiths. Find him south of the Village of Outcasts behind a row of dark skull rocks (Titan's Mitt required) and reunite him with his partner at the Smithy in the Light World.

title: Average Middle-Aged Man
description: This mysterious character won't talk to you until after you've acquired the Titan's Mitt and you've brought along the [Purple Treasure Chest](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430883) in the Dark World. He will now admit to being a former thief and will open the chest in exchange for your silence.

title: Lost Old Man
description: The Old Man, once rescued from the caves, will replenish your hearts when you talk to him.

title: Sweeping Grandma
description: Only found early in the quest. Sprinkle Magic Powder on her to turn her into a Fairy.

title: Running Kid
description: Use the Pegasus Shoes to catch up with him and you can talk to him. He'll just provide a basic tip: dash into trees to get items.

title: Flower Ring Transfer Point
description: Step into the circle and warp to the Light World to access the [Desert Plateau Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430151) via the [Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434757)

title: Light World Plateau Access Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror while inside the area with the pegs to be able to get to the Light World plateau [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434740) with the Hylian Plaque and [Bombos Medallion](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430170).

title: Hookshot Traversal Point
description: Use the Hookshot to get to the other side to the [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434746)

title: Desert Heart Cave Access Point
description: Warp to the Light World to get on top of the plateau with the entrance to the [Desert Heart Cave](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430870) Grants access to this Light World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434744)

title: Death Mountain Dark World Treasure Cave Access
description: Drop from the opening in the raised ledge

title: Light World Isle Access Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror here to access the isle at the Light World [Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434754)

title: Transition Point
description: Warp to this plateau via the Magic Mirror in the Light World, from the [Light World Plateau Access Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430171)

title: Transition Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror here to access a secret cave in the Light World, here: [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434743)

title: Transition Point
description: Access this area via the Dark World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434742)

title: Transition Point
description: Access this area via the Dark World [Desert Heart Cave Access Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430874)

title: Transition Point
description: Access from the [Dark World Warp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430157) under the rock to warp from

title: Transition Point
description: Access this side of the Dark World shore with the Hookshot from the [Hookshot Traversal Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430518) (one-way trip -- but you can jump into the water and swim north to get back across).

title: Transition Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror in the Dark World to access this plateau from the [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434750)

title: Transition Point
description: Use the Dark Mirror to access the Light World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434749)

title: Shortcut to Death Mountain
description: Jump to land back on the main plateau

title: Transfer Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror in the Dark World to access this isle from the [Light World Isle Access Point (Magic Mirror)](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=431356)

title: Transfer Point
description: Use the [Circle of Bushes Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430153) in the Dark World by using the Magic Mirror to access this plateau

title: Hookshot Transfer Point
description: Hookshot back to the previous [Hookshot Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434761)

title: Hookshot Transfer Point
description: Hookshot over to the other [Hookshot Transfer Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=434760)

title: Transfer Point
description: Access this area by warping from the Hyrule Castle [Dark World Warp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430154)

title: Transfer Point
description: Land here after using the [Dark World Warp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=429911) in the Light World

title: Transfer Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror to access this area via the Dark World's [Access Point to Hidden Crypt in the Light World](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430527)

title: Transfer Point
description: Access this plateau via the Light World's [Dark World Warp](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=430158)

title: Transition Point
description: Warp from the Dark World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=439896) to access this balcony.

title: Transition Point
description: Warp to the Light World here to gain access to a secret cave at the [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=439895).

title: Transition Point
description: Warp from the Dark World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=439900) to get to this hidden cave.

title: Transition Point
description: Use the Magic Mirror here to warp to the Light World [Transition Point](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-to-the-past/maps/world?locationIds=439899) and enter the Death Mountain Fairy Cave.
